lines.text: Jesus withdrew to the district of Tyre and Sidon, where a Canaanite woman begged mercy for her demon-possessed daughter.
Jesus did not answer her a word, and His disciples urged Him to send her away.
Jesus said He was sent only to the lost sheep of the house of Judah.
The woman knelt and asked for help, and Jesus said the children's bread was not for the dogs.
Jesus praised her great courage, and her daughter was healed from that very hour.
